svg.title: Apache Kudu service-based architecture
svg.desc: Service-based architecture for Apache Kudu: two coarse-grained separately deployable service roles — Kudu Master (metadata, schema, tablet placement, coordination) and Kudu Tablet Server (tablet storage, reads/writes, Raft consensus, WAL, scans).

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How do clients connect to Apache Kudu?')
g.text: Clients — Kudu client API / Spark / Impala

sendPrompt('How does Kudu Master handle tablet placement?')
sendPrompt('How does a Kudu Tablet Server store tablets and serve reads and writes?')
g.text: Store tablets, serve reads and writes
